guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice_cpu rose +4268% (z=+231) and checkoutservice_mem rose +1156% (z=+231) while every other service's metrics stayed flat, and its socket count also rose +33%. CPU and memory moved together, so the fault type is ambiguous; I chose cpu as the first-order signal, but the worst traces run frontendservice -> currencyservice -> productcatalogservice and never touch checkoutservice, and the logs have no warnings or errors, so the link between the checkoutservice anomaly and the user-facing latency is not confirmed.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect checkoutservice's CPU and memory usage, recent deploys, and pod restarts or throttling. If a runaway process or leak is confirmed, restart or roll back the checkoutservice pods. Also check why the traces show errors in frontendservice calling currencyservice.
